token_economy.json_double_encoding_note: Tool JSON is canonicalized once with compact separators and embedded as a single already-minimal JSON-text string; no second json.dumps pass or indent-driven padding is applied to it. Full nested-object (non-string) embedding for source_graph/session content was evaluated but rejected: it breaks the pinned regression fixtures in test_worker_project_context_b434_v1.py and test_worker_ai_infra_context_b437_v1.py, which call json.loads(section['content']) and require content to stay a parseable JSON string.
